1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 d6 4.Nxf7 Kxf7.strategy: Checks to keep the king out in the open for good, since it can no longer castle, and the bishop eyes the squares around it. White has paid a knight for two pawns, so the attack must keep its speed; Black can block and then challenge the bishop with a pawn.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 d6 4.Nxf7 Kxf7.name: Petrov's Defence: Cochrane Gambit, Bishop Check Line

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 d6 4.Nxf7 Kxf7.strategy: Takes the centre and opens the c1-bishop while the king is still stranded, with e5 in view to drive the knight away. It leaves e4 without a defender, but grabbing it loses: ...Nxe4 runs into Qh5+, and after Qd5+ White wins the knight back.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 d6 4.Nxf7 Kxf7.name: Petrov's Defence: Cochrane Gambit, Centre Variation
